manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the plastic soda bottle and the green bottle with white label together with both arms.

Task description: Use the left arm to grasp the dark plastic soda bottle with a red label on the left and the right arm for the green bottle with a white label on the right. Hold one in each arm, lift both, and bring them into their respective regions in front of the robot.

Success criteria: Each arm holds one bottle simultaneously. The red-label bottle must be above the left target region near the centerline directly in front of the robot, and the green bottle above the corresponding right region. Both must remain clearly suspended above the table. Merely grasping the bottles in place or slightly lifting them is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Prioritize the straight body below the red label on the red-labeled bottle and the narrowed section below the white label on the green bottle. Contact opposite sides at the same height, avoiding sloped shoulders and uneven bottom edges to reduce slipping.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected section of the bottle body. Before closing, use multiple views to confirm the fingers are on opposite sides, avoiding closing based only on image overlap and knocking the bottle over.
- Approach each bottle from the open side facing the robot and adjust the gripper direction in advance, leaving room for finger movement around the candlestick on the left, the box and round can in the middle, and the box on the right.
- When drawing the bottles toward the front of the robot, keep their bases clear of the table and nearby objects, keep the bottles nearly upright, and leave clearance for both bottles and grippers to reduce dragging, collisions, and squeezing.
- If it slips or tilts noticeably during lifting, first set the base back down on an open part of the table to support it, then adjust the grasp instead of releasing it unsupported.
